elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is limited to payments made during the 12 months prior to the event; it omits payable fees, the USD 1,000,000 floor, and the greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 applies to “Neither Customer nor M&I” and excludes indirect and consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 13.4 expressly states that breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No uncapped carve-out covers data protection or security obligations.
Section 13.4 expressly states that indemnification obligations are uncapped.
Section 13.4 expressly states that gross negligence is uncapped.
Section 13.4 expressly makes “willful misconduct” uncapped; the spelling variation does not change its meaning.
Fraud is not included among the uncapped carve-outs.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party’s intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that Customer payment obligations are outside capped damages; the collection proviso modifies the one-year action limitation, not the liability cap.
